annotations.title: Ask to put a site version live

description: Asks the founder to approve putting one Development version of the site (its number from site_status) on the public Live site, https://<slug>.gemmein.dev — the same files, copied; never new ones. The founder approves it in their browser, with the code Gemmein emails, and approving it carries it out, once; live_action_status (wait: true) answers PUBLISHED (env live) or FAILED. Refused before the app is live (not_live): until then there is only the Development site. Returns the approval link for the founder and a handle for live_action_status. This is what a founder may call putting the website live or making it real.
